name: Shade
source:
“I cannot say for certain… But surely, this too is part of my atonement.”

A devoted subordinate of Salinas, bound by an oath of absolute loyalty.
Though his allegiance to his master is unwavering, he harbors deep concern for Katarina, who suffers under Salinas’s cruelty, and quietly shields her from harm in secret.

[Translated from [url=https://mu-game.net/got/character/]the official website[/url].]

“I cannot say for certain… But surely, this too is part of my atonement.”

A devoted subordinate of Salinas, bound by an oath of absolute loyalty.
